name: DG 808S B21 mod
description: The DG808S B21 mod enhances the freeware DG808S glider for MSFS2020 and MSFS2024 by introducing improved compatibility and a refined flight model that eliminates high-speed stalls. Additionally, it features upgraded instruments, particularly focusing on the navigation panel. This add-on serves as a supplementary modification for users who have already installed the original DG808 glider package.
